blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Mayor Leni Robredo defended on Monday the P450 million national government funding for the rehabilitation of the Jesse M. Robredo Coliseum in Naga City, which Caloocan City Rep. Edgar Erice had questioned. Robredo said rehabilitation work is expected to begin in October, with the project now in the post-qualification stage after bidding was conducted in September. “Hopefully, construction can start within the month of October,” she said in a Facebook post.
